seo.title: Ibyo Duhana — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Isôoko Community Development (ICD) ni ikorera-ntabagenza riteza imbere urubyiruko n'abakobwa i Masoro, mu Rwanda, binyuze mu burezi, ubuzima n'ubucuruzi.

hero.title: Ibya Isôoko
hero.subtitle: Dushingiye i Masoro, dutegerezanya n'abaturage kuva mu 2019

story.title: Inkuru Yacu
story.subtitle: Kuva aho kubaho kugera ku rugerero rw'abaturage
story.body1: Mu 2019, Isôoko Learning and Sports Center (MLSC) yashinzwe kugira ngo ikemure ikibazo cy'ubuke bw'ibikoresho by'abaturage mu Karere ka Masoro — agace kari hafi y'umujyi mu Akarere ka Rulindo kafite ubushobozi buke bwo kugera ku bigo byo kwiga, ibikoresho bya siporo na mudasobwa. Hagati ya 2019 na 2021, MLSC yashyize mu bikorwa porogaramu eshanu: Ikoranabuhanga n'Uburezi, Isomero, Ubuzima, Siporo n'Imyidagaduro, ndetse n'Ubuyobozi n'Ubushobozi.
story.body2: Intsinzi y'iyi porogaramu yerekanye ko hakenewe ikigo giramba gishobora gukomeza iyi misi. Ni ko Isôoko Community Development (ICD) yavutse. Uyu munsi, ICD ikorera mu Isôoko Community Center — ahantu huzuyemo ibikoresho bya siporo, laboratwari ya mudasobwa, isomero n'ibiro bishyigikira ibikorwa by'uburezi n'ubutunzi by'abaturage bose.
story.body3: Masoro ni intangiriro gusa. Turagamije kugera muri buri mfuruka y'u Rwanda, duhaye abantu bacu — cyane cyane abakobwa n'urubyiruko — ibikoresho, ubumenyi n'icyizere bikenewe kugira ngo batebere. Kuko iyo ijwi rimwe rizamutse, rihahamira irindi.

mission.title: Intego
mission.text: Guhinga iterambere ryuzuye n'amahirwe, ku bakobwa n'urubyiruko, binyuze mu buzima bwiza, uburezi n'ubucuruzi.

vision.title: Icyerekezo
vision.text: Igihugu aho Abanyarwanda bose bahabwa ubumenyi n'ibikoresho bibatera imbaraga zo kugera ku bushobozi bwabo bwuzuye.

team.title: Itsinda Ryacu
team.subtitle: Twiyemeje ingaruka ku baturage
team.edQuote: Isôoko yavutse mu rukundo rwimbitse ku gihugu cyanjye no mu cyifuzo cyo gusubiza ku buryo bw'umumaro. Hamwe n'abaturage batangaje b'akarere ka Masoro, natangiye Isôoko Community Development ndi kumwe n'icyerekezo kimwe: guteza imbere urubyiruko n'abakobwa kugira ngo babone ijwi ryabo, bagere ku bushobozi bwabo, kandi babane ubuzima bugezweho mu by'ukuri. Ku miryango yabo, ku baturage babo, no ku Rwanda muri rusange.
